text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: C115a - Doping Offset: the Efficiency-versus-Loss Clearance Rule

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Closer dopants boost carrier density but absorb the mode - clearance >1.6 um keeps loss <1 dB/cm at high doping (Sec 6.4.1, Fig 6.16)

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Takeaway: pick the clearance by the loss budget - at high doping, >1.6 um for <1 dB/cm and 2.1 um for <0.1 dB/cm, the value used in Fig 6.14.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6
